aliases.description: kind: "tooling" only — additional namespaces the included tasks also register under.

excludes.description: kind: "tooling" only — fragment task names dropped before flattening or namespace registration.

flatten.description: kind: "tooling" only — when true, included task names register unprefixed instead of under the include namespace.

internal.description: kind: "tooling" only — when true, every task contributed by this include is hidden.

kind.description: The fragment content semantics: "landofile" is a Landofile fragment; "compose" is a Compose fragment routed through the same parser, rejection, and decode path; "tooling" is a tooling fragment carrying only tooling: and toolingIncludes:. This is not source transport.

namespace.description: kind: "tooling" only — the sub-namespace included tasks register under. Required unless flatten is true.

optional.description: kind: "tooling" only — when true, a missing fragment file is skipped instead of failing.

vars.description: kind: "tooling" only — literal vars applied to every included task unless the task defines its own value.
